title: Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported.

declaredVenue: 55 pages, 5 figures, plus 120 pages of supplementary material
